children.name: Nanodea muscosa C.F.Gaertn.
children.description: The sole accepted species of the monotypic genus Nanodea (sandalwood alliance, Santalaceae s.l. / Nanodeaceae), a small moss-like cushion- or mat-forming herb of the sub-Antarctic flora. Its native range is southern South America (Patagonian Argentina and Chile) and the Falkland Islands; the epithet 'muscosa' means mossy.
